neighbours.label: seasonal-cycle words in gardening/outdoor text (frost, seasonal, wintering, hibernate, deciduous): the season-timing slot
fire: Sow the pea seeds outdoors once the danger of frost is over.
The resort's outdoor terrace is only open during the summer season.

Before wintering the pool, lower the water below the skimmer.

Our campground offers seasonal sites from May to October.
Protect young shrubs from the first frosts with a fleece cover.
Tulip bulbs should go in the ground in the autumn months.
quiet: Sow the pea seeds outdoors in rows about two inches deep.
The resort's outdoor terrace is open to guests of all ages.
Many hedgehogs search for beetles under piles of leaves in the garden.
Before cleaning the pool, check the filter for any debris.
The maple is a tall tree with broad leaves and grey bark.
Our campground offers shaded sites close to the lake.
Protect young shrubs from rabbits with a wire mesh cover.

notes: Card logit effect: the - pole promotes ' season', ' winter', ' autumn'. Probe: 'after the last' already fires before 'frost'.
